name: HolyMind Piano Moments
request: Piano-key-led sound mixed with a subtle sonic detail that expresses the moment of each section, replacing the rejected electronic event beeps.

source.piano: Real recorded Salamander Grand Piano keys by Alexander Holm, distributed through Tonejs/audio
source.modifications: Left-channel selection, trimming, 32 kHz mono resampling, level adjustment, nearby-note repitching, envelopes, filtering, short reflections, original phrases and synthesized section textures

features.piano_leads: Actual recorded attacks and string decay lead every arrival/action cue; original v15 FM/gated electronic cue synthesis is removed. Texture RMS is capped below piano, quieter in About.
features.section_specific: Eleven authored piano/texture profiles: Hero, Orbit, Ribbon, Assembly, Workbench, Skill Instrument, Gallery, Services, About, Contact and Footer. Actual visual docks and originating action sections select the profile.
features.meaning: Orbit is open and airy; Assembly aligns keys with a quiet circuit join; Workbench is close/dry; Skills brighter with particles; Gallery restrained; Services grounded; About warm; Contact gently opens; Footer gathers. These are design intentions, not guaranteed emotional outcomes.
features.reverse: Return gestures reorder piano notes rather than reversing recordings. Shorter one-key/two-key actions keep the site from becoming a continuous song.
features.voice_control: One foreground phrase plus at most one short retiring release to avoid abrupt note cuts. Brain effects take priority; mute/background disposes voices.
features.loading: One first-party PCM bank loads without creating an AudioContext. Failed/late samples never substitute rejected beeps or replay stale notes.
features.preserved: Exact approved continuous soundscape and scroll instrument, fourteen Electric v12 brain presets, visual artwork, always-active motion, mobile-only brain-first layout, 34 skills and pinned 0–100–0 assembly.
features.audition: Eleven live scene audition buttons, forward/return comparison, everyday action keys, full moment reel and a 6.81-second four-scene preview. Old ambient comparisons remain clearly labelled as unchanged.

limitations.note: Automated checks establish waveform/bus output, event routing, actual section choices and lifecycle—not perceived emotion or speaker quality.
